name: Plate XXVIII: The Serpent Power
description: Kundalini coiled at the root, rising through the seven lotuses along Sushumna while Ida and Pingala cross at every gate. Struck in Citrinitas: the yellowing, the dawn of the solar light within the work. Degree of Initiate, rank 253 of the folio. “OMNIA AB VNO”: All things from the One.
